blocks.text: Heart Evangelista, Tuesday Vargas and other comedians took to social media to pay tribute to comedian Gil Aducal Morales, popularly known as Ate Gay, who died on Nov. 1 following his battle with cancer. Evangelista took to Instagram to share an art card dedicated to the late comedian, writing, “[crying emoji] rest na angel.” The actress also left a comment on the death announcement posted by Morales’ family, saying, “My love :( Kaya pala wala ka na sagot samin.” READ: Ate Gay reveals Heart Evangelista gives him financial help amid cancer battle In April, Morales revealed that Evangelista had been providing […]...
